versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is MACHINE-CHECKED: extraction/verify_all.py fails if it differs from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json. pageSpecVersion is const-locked in schema/pagespec.schema.json and verify_all.py checks every example and this manifest agree with it. repositoryVersion is a documentation-only, hand-maintained marker.

sourceProject.name: Operate clone (local replica of operate.so, a real live company site)
sourceProject.snapshotNote: A design-repo is a snapshot; re-diff its claims against the source when the source changes.

complianceNote: Reference-only. The source is a real company's live site: Operate's logos, copy, media, avatar art and commercial fonts, plus third-party integration logos, must not be reproduced by generated output. assets/asset-roles.json gives every role a closed availability (clone-only | generation-safe | blocked-for-generation, pinned in code in extraction/verify_all.py and schema/semantic_validate.py) and names generation-safe substitute roles (placeholder brand mark, placeholder integration glyph, fictional avatar, placeholder product visual, generated background texture, reserved-domain placeholder URL). PageSpec mode 'generation' is enforced by six rules (GENERATION_MODE_BRAND / _INTEGRATION_LOGO / _PERSON / _SCREENSHOT / _COPY / _URL; policy and source-derived patterns in assets/generation-policy.json). schema/example.generated*.pagespec.json are the generation-safe references, one per template family. Detection is string-based and no human has reviewed the pinned patterns. Do not publish this repository.
structurallyUnusual: Real company with licensed assets/fonts (see complianceNote).
/privacy and /terms body text is original placeholder copy with the original's structure.
Sign-up submits to a local stub only (src/lib/signupStub.js); booking-link redirect not implemented.
404 is the stock Next.js page, outside the design system.
The sign-up modal is an overlay state of template.home, not a route.
Two PageSpec modes: 'clone' (reference reconstruction, may use Operate assets/copy) and 'generation' (original page; only generation-safe roles and placeholders).

Legal pages: one section per H2-bounded part (legal.document-section, repeatable) plus header and preamble; the former whole-body section held 96-98% of each legal page at 1440px (extraction/measured-values.json wrapperGateDecomposition).
